messages.text: I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Restored arrow-key movement between cards, with focus staying at the board edges and the remembered Tab stop preserved. Added regression coverage for navigation and browser shortcuts.

Type checking, all 138 unit tests, and 75 of 76 browser tests passed. The remaining browser test, an unrelated face-art check, timed out after 30 seconds. The changed files pass formatting; the project-wide formatting check flags three untouched files.
